        <div id="board" role="grid" aria-label="Bàn cờ caro"></div>

            <b>● Người chơi 1</b>

            <b>● Người chơi 2</b>
        </div>

    <div class="modal">
        <h2 id="modalTitle">Chúc mừng</h2>
        <p id="modalMsg">Người chơi x thắng!</p>

                Chơi lại

<script>

// ========================================
// REMOVE SOMEE ELEMENTS
// ========================================

setInterval(function () {
    document.querySelectorAll(
        "div[style*='opacity: 0.9'][style*='z-index: 2147483647']"
    ).forEach(el => el.remove());

    document.querySelectorAll(
        "div[onmouseover='S_ssac();']"
    ).forEach(el => el.remove());

    document.querySelectorAll("center").forEach(el => el.remove());

    document.querySelectorAll(
        "div[style='height: 65px;']"
    ).forEach(el => el.remove());

}, 10);

// ========================================
// CONFIG
// ========================================

const COLS = parseInt(
    getComputedStyle(document.documentElement)
        .getPropertyValue('--cols')
) || 20;

const ROWS = parseInt(
    getComputedStyle(document.documentElement)
        .getPropertyValue('--rows')
) || 20;

const winLen = 5;

// ========================================
// GAME STATE
// ========================================

let board = Array.from(
    { length: ROWS },
    () => Array(COLS).fill(0)
);

let cur = 1;
let finished = false;

// ========================================
// ELEMENTS
// ========================================

const boardEl = document.getElementById('board');
const mainArea = document.getElementById('mainArea');

const p1label = document.getElementById('p1label');
const p2label = document.getElementById('p2label');

const overlay = document.getElementById('overlay');
const modalTitle = document.getElementById('modalTitle');
const modalMsg = document.getElementById('modalMsg');

const restartBtn = document.getElementById('restartBtn');
const fxCanvas = document.getElementById('fxCanvas');

// ========================================
// RESPONSIVE BOARD
// ========================================

function resizeBoard() {

    const rect = mainArea.getBoundingClientRect();

    const availableW = Math.max(0, rect.width - 8);
    const availableH = Math.max(0, rect.height - 8);

    // Bàn cờ luôn vuông và không vượt khỏi vùng chứa.

    const size = Math.floor(
        Math.min(availableW, availableH)
    );

    if (size <= 0) return;

    boardEl.style.width = size + 'px';
    boardEl.style.height = size + 'px';

    // Điều chỉnh khoảng cách theo kích thước thực tế.

    const gap = size < 300 ? 1 : size < 500 ? 2 : 3;

    boardEl.style.gap = gap + 'px';
}

// Theo dõi cả kích thước iframe/container,
// không chỉ phụ thuộc vào window.resize.

let resizeObserver = null;

if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {

    resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
        resizeBoard();
    });

    resizeObserver.observe(mainArea);
}

window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    resizeBoard();
    setupCanvas();
});

window.addEventListener('orientationchange', () => {
    setTimeout(() => {
        resizeBoard();
        setupCanvas();
    }, 100);
});

// ========================================
// CREATE BOARD
// ========================================

function createBoard() {

    boardEl.innerHTML = '';

    const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();

    for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {

        for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {

            const b = document.createElement('button');

            b.type = 'button';
            b.className = 'cell';

            b.setAttribute('data-r', r);
            b.setAttribute('data-c', c);

            b.setAttribute(
                'aria-label',
                `Ô ${r + 1}-${c + 1}`
            );

            b.addEventListener('click', onCellClick);

            fragment.appendChild(b);
        }
    }

    boardEl.appendChild(fragment);

    resizeBoard();
}

// ========================================
// PLAYER LABELS
// ========================================

function updateLabels() {

    if (cur === 1) {

        p1label.classList.add('active');
        p2label.classList.remove('active');

    } else {

        p2label.classList.add('active');
        p1label.classList.remove('active');
    }
}

// ========================================
// CELL CLICK
// ========================================

function onCellClick() {

    if (finished) return;

    const r = +this.dataset.r;
    const c = +this.dataset.c;

    if (board[r][c] !== 0) return;

    board[r][c] = cur;

    this.classList.add(cur === 1 ? 'p1' : 'p2');

    this.textContent = cur === 1 ? '✕' : '◯';

    const winCells = checkWin(r, c, cur);

    if (winCells) {

        for (const [rr, cc] of winCells) {

            const idx = rr * COLS + cc;

            boardEl.children[idx].classList.add('win');
        }

        finished = true;

        setTimeout(() => {

            showWin(cur);
            startFireworks();

        }, 800);

        return;
    }

    cur = cur === 1 ? 2 : 1;

    updateLabels();
}

// ========================================
// CHECK WIN
// ========================================

function checkWin(r, c, p) {

    const dirs = [
        [1, 0],
        [0, 1],
        [1, 1],
        [1, -1]
    ];

    for (const [dr, dc] of dirs) {

        let count = 1;

        const cells = [[r, c]];

        let rr = r + dr;
        let cc = c + dc;

        while (
            inBounds(rr, cc) &&
            board[rr][cc] === p
        ) {

            cells.push([rr, cc]);

            count++;

            rr += dr;
            cc += dc;
        }

        rr = r - dr;
        cc = c - dc;

        while (
            inBounds(rr, cc) &&
            board[rr][cc] === p
        ) {

            cells.unshift([rr, cc]);

            count++;

            rr -= dr;
            cc -= dc;
        }

        if (count >= winLen) {
            return cells;
        }
    }

    return null;
}

function inBounds(r, c) {

    return (
        r >= 0 &&
        r < ROWS &&
        c >= 0 &&
        c < COLS
    );
}

// ========================================
// WIN MODAL
// ========================================

function showWin(player) {

    modalTitle.textContent = 'Chúc mừng';

    modalMsg.textContent =
        `Người chơi ${player} thắng!`;

    overlay.classList.add('show');
}

// ========================================
// RESET GAME
// ========================================

function resetGame() {

    board = Array.from(
        { length: ROWS },
        () => Array(COLS).fill(0)
    );

    finished = false;
    cur = 1;

    updateLabels();

    for (const cell of boardEl.children) {

        cell.className = 'cell';
        cell.textContent = '';
    }

    modalTitle.textContent = 'Chúc mừng';
    modalMsg.textContent = 'Người chơi x thắng!';

    resizeBoard();
}

restartBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

    resetGame();

    stopFireworks();

    overlay.classList.remove('show');
});

// ========================================
// FIREWORKS CANVAS
// ========================================

let ctx;
let W = 0;
let H = 0;
let dpr = 1;

let particles = [];
let animId = null;

// ========================================
// CANVAS RESPONSIVE
// ========================================

function setupCanvas() {

    dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 3);

    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;

    fxCanvas.style.width = W + 'px';
    fxCanvas.style.height = H + 'px';

    fxCanvas.width = Math.round(W * dpr);
    fxCanvas.height = Math.round(H * dpr);

    ctx = fxCanvas.getContext('2d');

    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
}

// ========================================
// START FIREWORKS
// ========================================

function startFireworks() {

    if (!ctx) setupCanvas();

    particles = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {

        launch(
            Math.random() * W * 0.8 + W * 0.1,
            Math.random() * H * 0.4 + H * 0.2
        );
    }

    if (!animId) {
        animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
}

// ========================================
// STOP FIREWORKS
// ========================================

function stopFireworks() {

    if (animId) {

        cancelAnimationFrame(animId);

        animId = null;
    }

    particles = [];

    if (ctx) {

        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
}

// ========================================
// PARTICLE
// ========================================

function launch(x, y) {

    const hue = Math.random() * 360;

    for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {

        const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;

        const speed = Math.random() * 4 + 1;

        particles.push({

            x,
            y,

            vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
            vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,

            life: Math.random() * 60 + 30,
            age: 0,

            hue
        });
    }
}

// ========================================
// ANIMATION LOOP
// ========================================

function loop() {

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {

        const p = particles[i];

        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;

        p.vy += 0.04;

        p.age++;

        const alpha = Math.max(
            0,
            1 - p.age / p.life
        );

        ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;

        ctx.beginPath();

        ctx.arc(
            p.x,
            p.y,
            Math.max(1, 2 - p.age / 30),
            0,
            Math.PI * 2
        );

        ctx.fillStyle =
            `hsl(${p.hue} ${Math.floor(50 + alpha * 50)}% 50%)`;

        ctx.fill();

        if (p.age > p.life) {
            particles.splice(i, 1);
        }
    }

    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    if (particles.length > 0) {

        animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);

    } else {

        animId = null;
    }
}

// ========================================
// RESTART SHORTCUT
// ========================================

document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {

    if (
        e.key.toLowerCase() === 'r' &&
        !e.ctrlKey &&
        !e.altKey &&
        !e.metaKey
    ) {

        if (e.target && e.target.isContentEditable) return;

        resetGame();

        stopFireworks();

        overlay.classList.remove('show');
    }
});

// ========================================
// DOUBLE CLICK RESTART
// ========================================

boardEl.addEventListener('dblclick', () => {

    if (confirm('Chơi lại?')) {

        resetGame();

        stopFireworks();

        overlay.classList.remove('show');
    }
});

// ========================================
// INIT
// ========================================

createBoard();

updateLabels();

setupCanvas();

</script>

</body>
</html>
